# Johor Bahru Property Portal (jbpropertyportal.my)

> Property portal for new-launch residential projects in Johor Bahru, Malaysia, near the Johor Bahru–Singapore RTS Link and the Causeway (CIQ). 9 projects with developer pricing, floor plans and facilities, plus 10 buyer guides, 5 area guides and 4 developer profiles for Malaysian, Singaporean and foreign buyers. Managed by Yee Woei Shyan (REN 46305), IQI Realty Sdn Bhd. Not a developer website.

## Note
Official project listings (floor plans, prices, photos) are on https://www.jbproperties.my/project/<slug>; this site holds the English buying guides, area guides and developer profiles.

## Projects (9)

### Aethera Residences
- URL: https://www.jbpropertyportal.my/projects/aethera-residences
- Location: Ibrahim International Business District (IIBD), Johor
- Developer: UOA Group (UOA Development Bhd)
- Type: Serviced Apartment
- Tenure: Freehold
- Price: RM1,200,000 – RM5,000,000
- Built-up: 650 – 2,594 sq ft
- Bedrooms: 1-4
- Units: 786
- Floors: 52
- Completion: Under Construction 2029
- About: Rising above Johor Bahru's skyline, Aethera Residences blends contemporary design with everyday convenience.
